sdom pa gsum gyi smon lam don gnyis ngal bso bzhugs/ /na mo/rgyal ba kun gyi thugs bskyed mkha' klong las/ /phan bde'i sprin gyi bla bre mdzes pa

tei:div.tei:p: sdom pa gsum gyi smon lam don gnyis ngal bso bzhugs/ /

na mo/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs bskyed mkha' klong las/ / phan bde'i sprin gyi bla bre mdzes pa'i dbus/ / sdom gsum bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'jo ba yis/ / thar pa mchog gi myu gu bzhad par shog 1 / mthon mthing lcang lo'i zur phud bregs pa yis/ / srid pa'i 'ching ba ma lus brgal byas te/ / ngur smrig bla gos gsar pa'i gzi 'od kyis/ / sa gsum phan bde'i snang bas khyab gyur cig 2 / gzhi gsum cho ga'i rtsa ba legs brtan cing*/ / spangs dang 'jug pa'i tshul khrims yal ga rgyas/ / srid pa'i dgra bcom ge sar mdzes gyur pa'i/ / dam chos 'dul ba'i tshal brgya 'phel bar shog 3 / gzhan phan ga bur brtsegs pa'i mdza' bshes gyis/ / 'gro kun dga' ba'i kun+da rgyas pa dang*/ / lhan cig 'khor ba'i mun stug rab bcom ste/ / zag med bdud rtsi'i dpal gyis 'tsho bar shog 4 / spyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus dang*/ / bsam gtan shes rab nor bu'i 'khri shing cher/ / pha rol phyin pa'i lam la brten pa yis/ / byang chub mchog gi 'byor pas phyug par shog 5 / lung dang rtogs pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho che/ / shes rab gsum gyi gru gzing g.yo ba yis/ / rgyal gsung lam bden pha mthar brgal byas nas/ / thams cad mkhyen pa'i gling du phyin par shog 6 / legs bshad nyin byed gsar pa'i 'od zer gyis/ / skal bzang blo gros pad+mo bzhad pa dang*/ / lhan cig lam min mun pa bsal byas te/ / rgyal bstan snang bas yongs su khyab par shog 7 / chos brgyad 'ching ba rab grol dben gnas su/ / 'du 'dzi'i spyod pa ma lus ring dor te/ / rtse gcig ting 'dzin mchog la g.yo med pas/ / don gnyis ma lus lhun gyis grub par shog 8 / rdo rje theg pa'i brgyud 'dzin bum bzang nas/ / smin byed bdud rtsi'i thigs pas bran pa las/ / thar pa'i zhing sa rab tu brlan byas te/ / g.yel med dam tshigs bon chags par shog 9 / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rab bzung zhing*/

/ phra rags rnam par dbye ba rgyud la 'chang*/ / srung mtshams las 'das dbyings su grol ba yis/ / gsang sngags lam gyi de nyid mngon gyur shog 10 / bskyed rdzogs mdzes pa'i kha phrus bran pa las/ / rtsa rlung thig le'i gdung ba rab bcil te/ / sku bzhi'i pad dkar rgyas pa'i bsil g.yab tu/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i bsti gnas 'byung bar shog 11 / don dam gang du'ang mi gnas ye shes sems/ / lhan cig dga' ba'i rtse dgas rol par shog / tshur mthong rnam par grol ba'i 'khor lo che/ / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i ngo bor rtag brtan shog 12 / bslab gsum khrims kyi bdud rtsi rtag rol zhing*/ / zung 'jug bde dang stong pas rab myos pa'i/ / rig grol gnyis med dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sdes/ / srid pa'i khams kun dog por bgyid par shog 13 / de mthus tshogs gnyis dpyid kyis nyer drangs pa'i/ / rdzogs ldan dbyar gyi 'byor par spyod pa yis/ / 'gro kun nyon mongs tshogs rnams rab zhi ste/ / chos mthun dge ba'i dpal gyis 'tsho bar shog 14 / 'dis mtshon rnam dag smon pa'i dri bzhon gyis/ / bslab gsum sprin gyi bla bres bskul ba las/ / mngon mtho nges legs bdud rtsi'i dpal 'jo bas/ / 'gro kun srid pa'i tsha gdung bcil bar shog 15 /ces pa'ang srid las nges par grol ba'i blos bslab pa rin po che dam du 'chang ba ni bstan la smon pa yongs kyi nges brjod du snang ba'i phyir/ de'i rjes su smon pa tsam du rmongs brtul a bhā ya'i ming gis so// //
